title: Signed Magnitude Comparator
statement: Design a comparator for signed-magnitude numbers. Each 8-bit input uses bit 7 as the sign bit and bits 6:0 as magnitude. Positive numbers are greater than negative numbers, except equal magnitudes with equal signs are equal. The circuit is combinational.
module_signature: module signed_mag_compare(input [7:0] a, input [7:0] b, output reg gt, output reg eq, output reg lt);
behavior: a[7] and b[7] are sign bits where 1 means negative.
If signs differ, the positive operand is greater.
If both are negative, smaller magnitude is greater.
eq is 1 only when sign and magnitude match.
constraints: Do not convert to two's complement internally.
hint: Compare signs first, then compare magnitudes with reversed meaning for two negative values.
